weather_report:
A soft, pewter light hangs over Cottesloe this late winter morning, the kind that makes the ocean look thoughtful and the Norfolk pines a shade darker. Clouds are thickening and will shuffle in a few light showers through the late morning into the afternoon; the sun, when it peeks out, will be pale and brief. Expect a subdued day with softened edges and a slightly misted horizon—clean air, but not crystal. UV will stay modest under the blanket of cloud, nudging up only in the short breaks of brightness.

Dress in easy layers with a light, water-resistant shell and shoes that don’t mind wet pavement; tuck a compact umbrella in your bag and keep sunglasses handy for those quick, silvery openings. It’s a day for a slow coffee by a window, a lazy loop to the shops or library between showers, or a short, reflective walk along the foreshore when the drizzle lets up. Save the long beach laze for another day; today invites small errands, a train ride with a book, and the quiet pleasure of watching weather move across the water.
